page: ETag Middleware for HTTP caching with ETag headers. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {etag, RETAINED_304_HEADERS} from 'hono/etag'. Exports: RETAINED_304_HEADERS constant string array with default 304 response headers. HTTP headers: ETag, If-None-Match, If-Match. HTTP status: 304 Not Modified. Default hash algorithm: SHA-1. Default retained headers for 304 response: Cache-Control, Content-Location, Date, ETag, Expires, Vary. Options: weak (boolean, default false, adds 'w/' prefix for weak validation), retainedHeaders (string[] to add custom headers), generateDigest ((body: Uint8Array) => ArrayBuffer | Promise<ArrayBuffer> for custom hash function). Weak validation per MDN. Conditional request handling: If-None-Match comparison triggers 304 response. Questions: How to add ETag headers? What's weak validation? Which headers are retained in 304? Can I customize digest? Can I add custom headers to 304? How does ETag work? What's If-None-Match?

sections.manifest: Import statements for ETag middleware. import {Hono} from 'hono' for the main framework class. import {etag} from 'hono/etag' for the middleware function. Optional: import {RETAINED_304_HEADERS} from 'hono/etag' for default 304 header list. Questions: What to import? Where is etag located? What is RETAINED_304_HEADERS?

ETag middleware basic usage. app.use('/etag/*', etag()). Simple one-line implementation. Applies to paths matching /etag/*. Returns response with c.text('Hono is cool'). Middleware automatically generates and manages ETag headers. Questions: How to enable ETag? What's the simplest usage? Does it need configuration?

304 Response retained headers specification. 304 Not Modified response must include headers from equivalent 200 OK response. Default retained headers: Cache-Control, Content-Location, Date, ETag, Expires, Vary. Customization via retainedHeaders option. Pattern: etag({retainedHeaders: ['x-message', ...RETAINED_304_HEADERS]}) extends defaults. Export available: RETAINED_304_HEADERS as const string array. Can spread to combine custom headers with defaults. Example: adding 'x-message' custom header. Questions: What headers go in 304 responses? Can I customize retained headers? How to add custom headers? What's the default list? Can I extend defaults?

ETag middleware options specification. Optional: weak (boolean, default false, enables weak validation per MDN, adds 'w/' prefix to ETag value). Weak vs strong validation: weak doesn't require byte-for-byte match. Optional: retainedHeaders (string[] array of headers to include in 304 response, can combine with RETAINED_304_HEADERS export). Optional: generateDigest ((body: Uint8Array) => ArrayBuffer | Promise<ArrayBuffer>, custom hash function, default SHA-1). Function receives response body as Uint8Array. Returns hash as ArrayBuffer or Promise<ArrayBuffer> for async operations. Default algorithm: SHA-1. Questions: What options are available? What's weak validation? How to retain custom headers? Can I use different hash algorithms? How to implement generateDigest? Does it support async?
